skill.name: kegg-database
skill.description: Query KEGG REST APIs for pathway, gene, compound, enzyme, disease, and drug data. Use it for academic bioinformatics workflows that need direct KEGG access.
skill.summary: Query KEGG pathway, gene, compound, enzyme, disease, and drug data through the KEGG REST API.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code examples, KEGG biological identifiers, documentation URLs, and an ellipsis string. The Python helper performs expected HTTPS requests to the documented KEGG REST API. I found no evidence of prompt injection, command execution, filesystem access, credential theft, or covert exfiltration.

remediation.issue: Network requests depend on KEGG availability and user-provided query terms.
remediation.suggestion: Keep requests limited to rest.kegg.jp, avoid private data in query terms, and document outbound network behavior clearly.

remediation.issue: Helper requests do not set explicit timeouts or retry controls.
remediation.suggestion: Add request timeouts and polite retry handling to prevent hung sessions and excessive repeated calls.

remediation.issue: KEGG licensing limits are important for marketplace users.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the academic-use restriction visible in the skill description and usage guidance.

content.value_statement: Bioinformatics work often needs pathway, gene, compound, and drug mappings from KEGG. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code query KEGG REST APIs and interpret results.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve KEGG database metadata and release information.
List pathways, genes, compounds, enzymes, diseases, and drugs.
Search KEGG entries by keyword, formula, mass range, or molecular weight.
Retrieve complete entries, sequences, pathway images, KGML, and pathway JSON.
Convert identifiers between KEGG, NCBI, UniProt, PubChem, and ChEBI.
Map genes, compounds, reactions, enzymes, and pathways through KEGG links.
limitations: Requires network access to the public KEGG REST API.
KEGG API use is limited to academic users and academic use.
Most batch operations are limited to 10 entries per request.
The skill returns source data and does not validate medical or clinical conclusions.

use_cases.title: Map Genes To Pathways
use_cases.description: Find KEGG pathways linked to a gene list and retrieve pathway context for enrichment work.

use_cases.title: Analyze Metabolic Compounds
use_cases.description: Search compounds, map them to reactions, and identify related metabolic pathways.

use_cases.title: Check Drug Interaction Data
use_cases.description: Look up KEGG drug entries and summarize available drug-drug interaction records.

prompt_templates.title: Look Up A Pathway
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the KEGG entry for human glycolysis and summarize the pathway name, identifier, and main biological role.

prompt_templates.title: Map One Gene
prompt_templates.prompt: Use KEGG to find pathways linked to human TP53. Summarize each pathway and include the KEGG pathway identifiers.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Organism Pathways
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare KEGG glycolysis pathways for human, mouse, and yeast. Highlight shared pathway context and organism-specific identifiers.

prompt_templates.title: Integrate External IDs
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert human KEGG gene identifiers to UniProt and NCBI Gene IDs, then explain how the mappings support downstream analysis.

output_examples.output: A pathway summary with the KEGG identifier, pathway name, organism context, linked genes, and relevant data formats.
A concise list of linked pathways, each with an identifier, pathway name, and short biological interpretation.

output_examples.input: Check interactions for KEGG drug D00001.
output_examples.output: A drug interaction summary with available KEGG interaction records and a note to verify clinical relevance independently.

best_practices: Use stable KEGG identifiers when repeating queries.
Batch requests within KEGG limits and avoid rapid repeated calls.
Cache retrieved records when workflows reuse the same entries.
anti_patterns: Do not use the KEGG API for commercial work without proper licensing.
Do not treat KEGG drug data as clinical advice or prescribing guidance.
Do not send private patient or unpublished data as KEGG search terms.

faq.question: What does this skill connect to?
faq.answer: It connects to the KEGG REST API for public bioinformatics database queries.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: Yes. The helper functions make HTTPS requests to rest.kegg.jp.

faq.question: Can it retrieve pathway images?
faq.answer: Yes. KEGG supports pathway image retrieval for one entry at a time.

faq.question: Can it convert gene identifiers?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents conversion between KEGG, NCBI, UniProt, PubChem, and ChEBI identifiers.

faq.question: Is commercial use allowed?
faq.answer: The skill notes that KEGG API access is for academic users and academic use only.

faq.question: Can it make medical recommendations?
faq.answer: No. It retrieves database records, but users must verify medical and clinical conclusions independently.
